beginner.summary: No CI/CD experience assumed. Participants install Jenkins and build pipelines that check out code, build, test, package and deploy an application.
prerequisites: Has built a Java, Python or Node.js project locally
outcomes: Write declarative Jenkins pipelines stored in Git
Build, test, publish reports and archive artefacts
Deploy an application from a pipeline with credentials handled safely

subtopics: Unlocking Jenkins and the setup wizard
days.lab_task: Run Jenkins in Docker with a persistent volume, create a freestyle job that prints the build number and date, and show that history survives a container restart.
days.deliverable: Run command, job configuration and console output before and after restart
checks: Job and build history are still there
Participant explains where builds should run

days.topic: Building from Git with Freestyle Jobs
subtopics: Build steps with shell or batch
days.lab_task: Create a freestyle job that builds a sample Maven or Python project from GitHub on every push using a webhook, with a parameter for the target environment.
days.deliverable: Job configuration, webhook settings and build logs
checks: Build starts automatically from the webhook
Parameter value appears in the log
Build turns red with the error visible

days.lab_task: Write a Jenkinsfile with checkout, build, test and package stages and post actions, store it in the repository, and run it from a pipeline job.
days.deliverable: Jenkinsfile and the stage view of a successful run
checks: All four stages show with timings
Pipeline fails at the test stage and post failure runs

days.topic: Test Reports, Artefacts and Build Results
days.lab_task: Publish test results and coverage from the pipeline, archive the built package, mark the build unstable when coverage drops below 70%, and limit history to 20 builds.
days.deliverable: Pipeline changes, test trend chart and archived artefact

days.lab_task: Store a registry password and an SSH key as credentials, use them in the pipeline with withCredentials, and prove the password never appears in logs.
days.deliverable: Credential setup, pipeline changes and a log search
checks: Search the build log for the password
Use the credential from another folder
objectives: Keep secrets out of code and logs

days.topic: Multibranch Pipelines and Pull Request Builds
days.lab_task: Convert the job to a multibranch pipeline that builds every branch and pull request, reports status to GitHub, and only deploys from main.
days.deliverable: Multibranch configuration and a pull request showing the Jenkins check
checks: Jenkins builds it and reports a check
Its job is removed after the scan
objectives: Build branches and pull requests automatically

subtopics: Why not build on the controller
days.lab_task: Add two agents with different labels, set the controller to zero executors, and run Java builds on one agent and Python builds on the other.
days.deliverable: Agent configuration and build logs showing where each ran
checks: Each runs on the agent with its label
Builds for that label wait in the queue

days.lab_task: Extend the pipeline to build a Docker image, tag it with the version and Git commit, scan it with Trivy, and push it to a registry only from main.
days.deliverable: Pipeline changes, scan report and registry listing
checks: Image is pushed with version and commit tags
Image is built and scanned but not pushed
objectives: Build and publish images from Jenkins

subtopics: Deploying to a server over SSH
days.lab_task: Add dev, test and prod deployment stages with an approval before prod, smoke tests after each deployment, and an automatic rollback when the prod smoke test fails.
days.deliverable: Pipeline changes and runs showing a successful deploy and a rollback
checks: Make the prod smoke test fail
Shows which build is in each environment

days.topic: Pipeline Logic: Parallel Stages, Conditions and Matrix Builds
days.lab_task: Run unit, lint and security checks in parallel, test on three runtime versions with a matrix, and add timeouts and retries to flaky network steps.
days.deliverable: Pipeline changes and timing comparison with the sequential version
checks: Parallel version is faster, with figures
Three runtime versions run and report separately
objectives: Speed up pipelines with parallel stages
Test across versions with matrix builds

subtopics: Library structure: vars, src and resources
days.lab_task: Create a shared library with a buildAndTest step and a dockerPublish step, and use it to shrink two project Jenkinsfiles to under 15 lines each.
days.deliverable: Library repository and the two shortened Jenkinsfiles
checks: Pin the library to a tag and change main
Projects still use the pinned version

days.lab_task: Describe the Jenkins configuration, tools and credentials references in a JCasC YAML file, rebuild Jenkins from it in a new container, and check plugin security advisories.
days.deliverable: JCasC file, plugins list and the rebuilt instance
checks: Start a fresh Jenkins with the YAML
Configuration and tools match the original
Vulnerable plugins are updated or listed with a plan

days.lab_task: Set up roles so developers can run but not configure jobs in their folder, only admins reach the script console, and every configuration change is logged.
days.deliverable: Role configuration, test results and audit log entries
checks: Developer tries to change a job
Configure option is missing and saving is denied
Access denied page for the script console
Change a job as an admin
Change appears in the audit log

days.lab_task: Add SonarQube analysis to the pipeline, fail the build when the quality gate fails, and show the result on the pull request.
days.deliverable: Pipeline changes, SonarQube project and a failing and passing run

days.lab_task: Send a chat message when main breaks and when it recovers, add a build badge to the README, and set build descriptions showing the version deployed.
days.deliverable: Notification configuration, chat messages and README badge

subtopics: Containers per tool in one pod
Running Jenkins on Kubernetes with Helm
days.lab_task: Run Jenkins on a local Kubernetes cluster with Helm and build the project in on-demand agent pods with separate containers for Maven and Docker tools.
days.deliverable: Helm values, pod template and a build log from a pod agent
checks: Three agent pods start and finish
Each step ran in the right container

days.lab_task: Fix six broken pipelines prepared by the trainer (syntax error, missing credential, offline agent, full disk, wrong tool version, hung step) and record cause, evidence and fix.
days.deliverable: Troubleshooting log for all six
checks: Fix all six within the time limit
Cause and clean-up step are recorded
Use Replay to test a fix

days.lab_task: Back up Jenkins, upgrade it and its plugins on a test copy, then restore the backup on a new container and confirm jobs and credentials work.
days.deliverable: Backup procedure, upgrade log and restore evidence
checks: Run the pipeline on the upgraded copy
Old builds are removed as configured

days.topic: End-to-End CI/CD for a Web Application
days.lab_task: Build a complete pipeline for a three-tier web application covering build, test, quality gate, image scan, publish, test and prod deployment with approval, smoke tests and notifications.
days.deliverable: Jenkinsfile, shared library use and a pipeline run reaching prod
checks: All stages pass and prod shows the new version
Explains each stage and how to roll back
objectives: Combine quality, security and deployment stages

days.lab_task: Deliver Jenkins configured as code with agents, credentials, a shared library and a multibranch pipeline that deploys an application with gates, approval and rollback, then demonstrate a failure and recovery.
days.deliverable: Configuration repository, pipeline repositories and a 10-minute demo
checks: Rebuild Jenkins from configuration during the demo
Deploy a broken version to prod

intermediate.summary: For people who maintain Jenkins pipelines. Covers advanced pipeline design, shared library engineering, scaling agents, security hardening, observability, supply chain and migration to modern CI/CD.
prerequisites: Writes declarative pipelines and uses shared libraries
outcomes: Design maintainable, fast pipelines for many projects
Scale and secure Jenkins for many teams
Observe Jenkins and plan migrations to other CI systems

subtopics: Rolling out changes to many projects
days.lab_task: Design a standard pipeline driven by a small project config file, apply it to five sample projects with different languages, and roll out a template change safely.
days.deliverable: Template library, five project configurations and the rollout record
checks: All succeed with their language-specific steps
Roll out a template change to one project first
Only that project uses the new version

days.lab_task: Refactor the shared library into tested classes, write unit tests with JenkinsPipelineUnit, fix a CPS serialisation bug, and release a new version.
days.deliverable: Library code, tests and a release
checks: Run a pipeline with the old CPS bug
Fails with NotSerializableException, and the fix removes it
Pin a project to the new release

days.topic: Scaling Agents: Cloud and Kubernetes Elastic Builds
subtopics: EC2 and Azure VM agent plugins
days.lab_task: Replace static agents with elastic Kubernetes and spot VM agents, cache dependencies, and compare queue time, build time and cost for 50 queued builds.
days.deliverable: Agent configuration and a comparison report
checks: Agents scale up and the queue drains within the target time
Compare build time with the cache
Build is retried on another agent

subtopics: Restricting which jobs use which credentials
Running Jenkins behind a reverse proxy with TLS
days.lab_task: Harden a deliberately weak Jenkins: put it behind TLS with SSO, restrict credentials by folder, isolate agents, and show three attack attempts now fail.
days.deliverable: Hardening checklist, configuration and attack test results
checks: Use a prod credential from a dev folder job
Run an unapproved Groovy method in a pipeline
objectives: Find and close Jenkins security gaps

days.topic: Supply Chain Security in Jenkins Pipelines
days.lab_task: Generate SBOMs, sign images and attach provenance in the pipeline, and refuse to deploy any artefact whose signature does not verify.
days.deliverable: Pipeline changes, SBOMs, signatures and a refused deployment

days.lab_task: Export Jenkins metrics and pipeline traces, build a dashboard of queue time, failure rate and slow stages, and alert when the queue waits more than 10 minutes.
days.deliverable: Dashboard, alert rule and a pipeline trace

days.lab_task: Cut a provided 40-minute pipeline to under 12 minutes using caching, parallel test splitting, shallow checkout and stage skipping, measuring each change.
days.deliverable: Optimised pipeline and a timing table per change
checks: Each change has a measured effect

days.topic: Jenkins High Availability and Disaster Recovery
subtopics: Controller as a single point of failure
days.lab_task: Run two controllers for different teams on Kubernetes with persistent storage, delete one controller pod and its node, and recover within the stated time.
days.deliverable: Controller setup, recovery runbook and timed recovery
checks: Comes back with jobs and history
Rebuild a controller from JCasC on new storage
Compare recovery time with the target

days.lab_task: Implement a canary release from Jenkins to Kubernetes with automatic promotion on healthy metrics, then hand off deployment to Argo CD by updating a GitOps repository.
days.deliverable: Pipeline changes, canary run record and GitOps handoff evidence
checks: Jenkins commits the new tag and Argo CD deploys it

days.topic: Infrastructure Pipelines with Terraform and Ansible
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that plans Terraform on pull requests, applies the saved plan after approval on main, then configures servers with Ansible and runs a nightly drift check.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, plan artefacts and drift job results
checks: Plan is attached to the build
Saved plan is applied and Ansible runs

days.lab_task: Add integration tests with disposable dependencies, a k6 performance gate and an OWASP ZAP baseline scan, and quarantine a flaky test automatically.
days.deliverable: Pipeline changes and runs showing each test type
checks: Make p95 latency exceed the gate

days.lab_task: Make security and approval stages mandatory for regulated projects, trace a prod deployment back to its commit, tests and approver, and produce an audit report.
days.deliverable: Governance configuration, traceability record and audit report
checks: Remove the security stage from a regulated Jenkinsfile
Commit, tests, scans and approver are linked

days.topic: Jenkins for Mobile and Desktop Builds
days.lab_task: Build and test an Android app in Jenkins, sign it with a stored key, and distribute the test build, documenting how an iOS build would differ.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, signed build and the iOS differences note
checks: Signed APK is produced and tests pass
Search logs for the keystore password

days.lab_task: Build a monorepo of six projects so that a change only builds and tests the affected projects and their dependants, and compare build time with a full build.
days.deliverable: Pipeline changes and a timing comparison
checks: It and its dependants are built
objectives: Keep builds fast as code grows

days.lab_task: Create folders, permissions and jobs for 10 teams with Job DSL, set up plugin governance, and run a planned upgrade with a communication plan.
days.deliverable: Job DSL scripts, governance rules and upgrade record
checks: All team folders and jobs are created
Done within the window with no failed builds after

days.lab_task: Connect Jenkins to Jira and Nexus so builds update Jira issues and publish artefacts to Nexus, and trigger a pipeline from an external script through the REST API.
days.deliverable: Integration configuration and evidence of each integration
checks: Build a commit mentioning an issue key
Artefact is published with its version
Pipeline starts with the given parameters

days.lab_task: Measure CI cost per team for a month of sample builds, cut cost by at least 30% with spot agents, idle shutdown and caching, and report the savings.
days.deliverable: Cost model, changes and a savings report

days.topic: Migrating from Jenkins to Other CI Systems
subtopics: Mapping Jenkinsfiles to GitHub Actions or GitLab CI
Migration tools such as GitHub Actions Importer
days.lab_task: Migrate two Jenkins pipelines to GitHub Actions with the importer, fix what it could not translate, run both in parallel to prove parity, and write a migration plan for the rest.
days.deliverable: Migrated workflows, parity comparison and migration plan
checks: Run both systems on the same commit
Read the list of manual fixes

days.lab_task: Handle four injected Jenkins incidents using runbooks you write, collect a support bundle and thread dump for one, and complete a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Four runbooks, incident timelines and one review
checks: Cause found from the thread dump
Rolled back or fixed with builds working
Includes impact, cause and owned actions

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: CI/CD Platform for Ten Teams
subtopics: Standard pipelines and tested shared library
days.lab_task: Build a Jenkins platform for ten teams with standard pipelines, a tested shared library, elastic agents, hardened security, signed artefacts, dashboards and runbooks, then present it.
days.deliverable: Platform repositories, dashboards, runbooks and a 15-minute demo
checks: Onboard a new team with the seed job
Team builds within the target time
Agents scale and queue drains within target
objectives: Design a CI/CD platform for many teams

advanced.summary: For engineers who own CI/CD for large organisations. Covers Jenkins internals, extreme scale, plugin development, secure build systems, platform strategy and modernising CI/CD.
prerequisites: Has administered Jenkins for many teams
Comfortable with Kubernetes, security tooling and observability
outcomes: Diagnose Jenkins at the JVM and plugin level
Run CI/CD at very large scale with measured performance
Set CI/CD platform strategy and lead modernisation

days.topic: Jenkins Internals: Controller, Remoting and the Pipeline Engine
subtopics: Remoting protocol between controller and agents
days.lab_task: Trace how a pipeline step runs from the controller to an agent, change durability settings and measure the effect on throughput, and explain build storage on disk.
days.deliverable: Annotated trace, durability benchmark and storage diagram
checks: Build XML, logs and workflow files are identified
Pipeline resumes or fails as the durability setting predicts

days.lab_task: Diagnose a provided slow controller with GC logs, thread dumps and a heap dump, identify the leaking plugin, and tune the JVM to meet response time targets.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis report, fixes and before and after response times
checks: Plugin and object type found in the heap dump

subtopics: Thousands of jobs and builds a day
days.lab_task: Load test a controller with simulated builds until it degrades, then shard teams across controllers, offload artefacts and logs, and retest.
days.deliverable: Load test reports before and after and the sharding design
checks: Compare the load at which it degrades
objectives: Run CI at very large scale

days.lab_task: Write a plugin that adds a pipeline step to post deployment records to an internal API, with configuration, tests using JenkinsRule and secure credential handling.
days.deliverable: Plugin source, tests and a pipeline using the step
checks: Use the step in a pipeline
Record appears in the internal API
Check the plugin for credential leaks

days.lab_task: Assess a Jenkins setup against SLSA build level 3, close the main gaps with ephemeral isolated agents and signed provenance, and verify provenance at deploy time.
days.deliverable: Gap assessment, changes and verification evidence
checks: Each SLSA requirement is assessed with evidence
Try to forge provenance from a job
Fails because signing keys are not reachable from builds

subtopics: Network isolation for controllers and agents
days.lab_task: Threat model the CI platform, run a red team exercise with a malicious pull request trying to steal secrets, fix the gaps, and add detection for similar attempts.
days.deliverable: Threat model, red team report, fixes and detection rules
checks: Covers each stage of the pipeline

days.lab_task: Add a remote build cache and remote execution for a large build, measure hit rates and build time, and show a cache poisoning control works.
days.deliverable: Cache configuration, measurements and the poisoning test
checks: Large improvement with the cache, with figures
Try to write to the cache from an untrusted build
objectives: Speed up builds with remote caching

subtopics: SLOs for CI: queue time, build success, availability
Dependency failures: Git, registries, artefact stores
days.lab_task: Define SLOs for the CI platform, run chaos tests for Git and registry outages, add mitigations such as mirrors and retries, and report SLO impact.
days.deliverable: SLO definitions, chaos results, mitigations and SLO report
checks: Take the registry down during builds
Builds use the mirror and succeed

days.topic: Developer Experience and Platform Product Thinking
days.lab_task: Measure developer wait time and satisfaction for the CI platform, build a self-service template that creates a repository with a working pipeline, and measure the effect.
days.deliverable: Measurement report, template and before and after metrics
checks: Create a project from the template
First pipeline passes within the target time
Top complaints are linked to roadmap items

days.lab_task: Automate change records and evidence collection for prod deployments, integrate with a change management system, and run a mock audit of a quarter's releases.
days.deliverable: Evidence automation, change integration and mock audit results
checks: Change record is created and closed automatically
Evidence for a release is produced within minutes
Author cannot approve their own prod release

subtopics: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI and others compared
When to run several CI systems
days.lab_task: Implement the same standard pipeline in Jenkins, GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, compare effort, speed, security and cost, and write a platform decision record.
days.deliverable: Three implementations, comparison and decision record
checks: Run all three on the same commit
Measured speed and estimated cost for each

days.topic: Large-Scale Migration Off or Onto Jenkins
days.lab_task: Inventory 300 sample jobs, classify them, plan migration waves, migrate a pilot wave automatically, and report progress and blockers.
days.deliverable: Inventory, classification, wave plan and pilot report
checks: Each job has a complexity class and reason
Each blocker has an owner and plan
objectives: Plan migrations of hundreds of pipelines

days.lab_task: Orchestrate a release of five dependent services in the right order with health checks between steps, and roll back all of them when the fourth fails.
days.deliverable: Orchestration pipeline and release records for success and rollback

days.lab_task: Cut the cost of a provided build platform by at least 35% while keeping CI SLOs, and publish cost per team and per build minute.
days.deliverable: Cost analysis, changes, SLO evidence and cost report

days.lab_task: Build a failure-classification step that summarises failed build logs and suggests likely causes, evaluate it on 50 past failures, and set rules for safe use.
days.deliverable: Classification step, evaluation results and usage rules
checks: Accuracy is measured against labelled causes
Secrets and personal data are removed first

subtopics: Network and DNS problems for agents
days.lab_task: Diagnose and fix seven hard CI platform failures injected by the trainer, including remoting disconnects, a pipeline that never resumes and a plugin conflict.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis log with symptom, evidence, root cause and fix for each
checks: Root cause found and agents stable

days.lab_task: Write OPA policies for pipeline definitions requiring approved images, mandatory security steps and no inline secrets, enforce them across projects, and report results.
days.deliverable: Policies, tests, enforcement configuration and a policy report

subtopics: Speed, security, cost and reliability criteria
days.lab_task: Review another team's CI/CD platform design, write two decision records for its biggest risks, and present recommendations with evidence.
days.deliverable: Review report, two decision records and a 10-minute presentation
checks: Each high risk has evidence and a recommendation
Options, criteria and the reason for the choice
Defended with cost and risk evidence

days.lab_task: Assess a provided organisation's CI/CD maturity, propose a modernisation roadmap including Jenkins' future role, and present it to a mock leadership panel.
days.deliverable: Maturity assessment, roadmap and presentation
checks: Each area has evidence and a level
Items have outcomes, owners and metrics
Budget and risk questions answered with evidence

days.lab_task: Design and prototype an enterprise CI/CD platform covering scale, trusted builds, policy, compliance, reliability, cost and developer experience, then defend it to a review board.
days.deliverable: Architecture document, working prototype, security and reliability test evidence, cost model and a 20-minute review presentation
checks: Untrusted or non-compliant builds are blocked
CI SLOs met during dependency failures
Costs are broken down and justified
objectives: Prove security, reliability and cost with evidence
Defend the design to a review board
